test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following Indian states does NOT share its boundaries with Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nepal **shares a border with **five Indian states: Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Sikkim**, which spans 1850 kilometres.
 
• Jharkhand is bordered on the **north by Bihar, on the west by Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, on the south by Odisha, and on the east by West Bengal**.
 
• **"Jharkhand" literally means "Land of Forests.**" The Bihar Reorganization Act established the 28th state of the Indian Union on November 15, 2000, the birth anniversary of the legendary Bhagwan Birsa Munda.
 
• **Ranchi is the state's capital,** with Dumka serving as a sub-capital. Jamshedpur is the state's largest and most industrial city.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Nepal is a landlocked South Asian country**. It is primarily located in the Himalayas, but also contains parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain, bordering Tibet in China to the north and India to the south, east, and west, with the Siliguri Corridor separating it from Bangladesh and Bhutan, respectively.
 
• Nepal is a multiethnic, multilingual, multireligious, and multicultural country with Nepali as its official language.
 
• **Kathmandu is the capital and largest city of Nepal.**
